content_sections.heading: NCDC Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: The official notification lists 30 vacancies across 16 post entries in public health, epidemiology, microbiology, biosafety, finance, data analysis and related fields. Note: The notification lists Data Analyst in two separate entries with different eligibility requirements and remuneration. Candidates should check the correct position before applying. content_sections.heading: NCDC Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: The National Centre for Disease Control has published the official notification for 30 contractual posts for the financial year 2026-27. The notice contains the complete eligibility requirements, post-wise remuneration, age limits, responsibilities, contractual conditions and application form. Official Notification PDF: Download NCDC Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: NCDC Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Eligibility varies by position. Applicants must possess the relevant qualifications and required post-qualification experience specified for their chosen post. Important: Several posts have alternative qualification routes and specific experience conditions. Applicants must read the detailed requirements for their selected post in the official notification before submitting the form.

rows.educational_qualification_and_experience: Prescribed MBBS with MD/DNB in Public Health-related disciplines, or MBBS with EIS training certificate, or the specified non-medical Public Health/Epidemiology qualification route. Minimum 3 years of relevant experience under the notified conditions.
Bachelor's Degree in Food Science, Food Technology, Nutrition, Microbiology, Public Health or related field, or Certified Professional in Food Safety (CP-FS).

Postgraduate qualification in Veterinary Public Health, Veterinary Epidemiology, Veterinary Medicine, Veterinary Microbiology, Veterinary Preventive Medicine or Veterinary Pathology, with the prescribed veterinary registration and 3 years of relevant experience.
M.Sc. in Chemistry or equivalent, or Ph.D. in Chemistry, Biochemistry or Toxicology, with at least 3 years of relevant post-qualification experience.
Graduate Degree in Mass Communication, Digital Media or PR with 5 years of experience, or Postgraduate Diploma in the specified field with 3 years of experience.
Graduation with MBA in HR or PG Diploma in HR, and minimum 5 years of relevant post-qualification experience.
M.Sc. and Ph.D. in Medical Microbiology, Microbiology, Biotechnology or Biomedical Sciences, with minimum 7 years of experience in the specified field.
Prescribed medical or non-medical Public Health/Epidemiology qualifications with relevant experience under the notification.

Bachelor's Degree in Biology, Microbiology, Environmental Science, Public Health or related field with 5 years of experience; alternatively, Master's/Ph.D. in a specified related field with 3 years of experience.
Bachelor's Degree in Biology, Microbiology, Biochemistry or related field with 3 years of experience, or Master's/Ph.D. in Biosafety, Public Health or related field with 1 year of experience.
BCA/MCA with the prescribed 5/3 years of post-qualification experience, respectively.
MBBS with MD or DNB in the specified Community Medicine, Preventive Medicine, Community Health Administration or Field Epidemiology discipline, and minimum 3 years of relevant experience.
MBA (Finance) or PGDBM/PGDBA (Finance) with minimum 5 years of accounting and prescribed finance-related experience.
MD in Community Medicine, Preventive and Social Medicine or Community Health Administration with at least 3 years of post-qualification experience in Public Health.
MD in the prescribed Public Health discipline or EIS Master in Applied Epidemiology, with at least 1 year of relevant post-qualification experience.
Bachelor's Degree in any discipline with Degree/Diploma in Computer Application and minimum 3 years of experience as a Data Analyst.

content_sections.heading: NCDC Recruitment 2026 Age Limit
content_sections.text: The maximum age limit is 40 or 45 years , depending on the position.

content_sections.heading: NCDC Recruitment 2026 Salary
content_sections.text: The notification specifies fixed consolidated monthly remuneration ranging from Rs. 60,000 to Rs. 1,50,000 , depending on the post. These are consolidated contractual remuneration amounts, not regular government pay scales. The notification does not provide additional separate allowances or a detailed in-hand salary calculation.

content_sections.heading: NCDC Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection will be conducted through screening of applications followed by an interview for eligible candidates. Scrutiny of submitted applications and supporting documents. Shortlisting based on the prescribed eligibility criteria and Terms of Reference (ToR). Interview of shortlisted eligible candidates. Final selection and contractual engagement, subject to applicable conditions. Only eligible shortlisted candidates will receive an email informing them of the interview date and time. The notification does not prescribe a separate written examination.

content_sections.heading: NCDC Recruitment 2026 Apply Offline
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates must submit the prescribed application form through Speed Post or hand delivery to the General Services Section of NCDC, Delhi. Applications must reach the office on or before 9 November 2026 . General Services Section Room No. 202, National Centre for Disease Control (NCDC), 22, Sham Nath Marg, Delhi - 110054. Office Submission Hours: 10:00 AM to 5:00 PM on working days. Important: Applications received after 9 November 2026 will not be accepted. The date of dispatch is not a substitute for timely receipt by NCDC.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NCDC Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Visit the official NCDC website at ncdc.mohfw.gov.in . Open the Vacancies section under Work With Us. Download the notification for engagement of 30 contractual human resources. Read the post-specific qualifications, experience and age criteria. Print the application form included on pages 10 and 11 of the notification. Fill in the post applied for, personal information, educational qualifications, experience and contact details. Attach a self-attested photograph and the applicable educational, experience, age-proof and supporting documents. Check that the form is complete and that the required copies are self-attested. Send the completed application through Speed Post or submit it by hand at the designated NCDC office. Ensure the application reaches NCDC by 9 November 2026. Check the registered email address for interview communication if shortlisted.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for NCDC Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates should submit the supporting documents relevant to their qualifications and experience along with the prescribed application form. Completed application form. Self-attested photograph. Degree, diploma and professional qualification certificates. Relevant experience certificates. Age-proof document. Supporting documents for other claims made in the application. The application form also asks for reference details, training or short courses attended, awards or achievements, mailing address, permanent address, phone number and email ID.

content_sections.heading: NCDC Recruitment 2026 Contract Terms and Conditions
content_sections.text: The initial contractual engagement is for one year. Continuation will depend on yearly requirements. Selected candidates must sign a Contractual Service Agreement at the time of joining. Contractual personnel will not be treated as regular NCDC employees. Contractual engagement does not provide any claim for permanent government appointment. No TA will be paid for attending the interview. No separate medical facility or additional financial allowance is provided beyond the consolidated remuneration under the stated conditions. Annual leave of 30 days and 10 days of casual or sick leave are provided as specified in the notice. Either party may terminate the service by giving one month's notice.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the National Centre for Disease Control (NCDC) under the Directorate General of Health Services.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under NCDC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 30 vacancies available for various posts including Public Health Specialist, Technical Officer, Consultant, and others.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application form is 09 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application for NCDC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application mode is strictly offline. Candidates must send their applications via speed post or by hand to the designated address.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for these positions?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is generally set at 45 years or 40 years depending on the specific post applied for.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary range for NCDC vacancies?
faq.answer: The salary ranges from Rs. 60,000 to Rs. 1,50,000 per month depending on the post and qualifications.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee required?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for applying to these positions.

faq.question: Q8. What qualifications are needed for Public Health Specialist posts?
faq.answer: Candidates need an MBBS degree with MD/DNB in relevant subjects like Social and Preventive Medicine, Community Medicine, or equivalent non-medical degrees with MPH.

faq.question: Q9. Where should the completed application be sent?
faq.answer: Applications should be sent to the General Services Section, Room No. 202, NCDC, 22 - Sham Nath Marg, Delhi - 110054.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for NCDC posts?
faq.answer: The selection process involves a screening cum selection mode followed by an interview.
